pages.title: Dawn Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §rAfter 'Though We Fall, We Remain', kill a Wither at night while holding a Dawn-enchanted weapon.$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)While held or embedded in armor, hostile kills build Morning Light; a Dawn weapon in the main hand builds it faster. At 10 charges, 'Dawn' activates.

pages.title: Dawn Resonance
pages.text: §l'Dawn' state: §rLasts 180 seconds with Morning Light held at 10. Damage ×1.25, critical chance and movement speed +10%, and restore 2.5 HP every 2 seconds. When it ends, charges clear and a 90-second cooldown begins.$(br2)Players and maids build charges independently; for maids, a star in either hand, a Curios slot, or embedded armor counts.
